lesson.name: Learn the Sicilian Dragon
lesson.description: Learn the essentials of the Sicilian Dragon with this video on key plans and attacking ideas for both sides.

{White is ahead by a rook, but Black is OK. How can you win material?} 14...
Bf5 {[%wrong White is winning. Try again.] [%hint Threaten mate on c2.]} (14...
Qe5 $2 15. Kd2 {White is winning. Try again.}) (14... Bb7 $2 15. Qxa7 {White
has a winning material advantage. Try again and look for a better way to
attack the white queen.}) (14... Bd7 $2 15. Qxa7 {White has a winning material
advantage. Try again and look for a better way to attack the white queen.}) (
14... Be6 $2 15. Qxa7 {White has a winning material advantage. Try again and
look for a better way to attack the white queen.}) 15. Qxf8+ {Great move!
White has nothing better than returning the queen. How should you recapture?}
Kxf8 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find it.] [%hint Capture on f8
without making your bishop less active.] Well played! White must play very
precisely to avoid a quick loss.} (15... Bxf8 $2 16. Bd3 {White is slightly
better because the bishop is passive on f8. Try to find a stronger move.}) *

{White has defended poorly and Black has a winning move. What should you play?
} 16... Qe5 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Look for a winning fork and try
again.] [%hint Fork the e3 bishop and the b2 pawn.]} (16... Bxd3 $2 17. Rxd3 {
White is better. Try to find a stronger move.}) (16... Bxb2+ $2 17. Kxb2 {
White is OK. Try to find a stronger move.}) (16... Qb6 $2 17. Bxb6 {White is
winning. Try to find a stronger queen move.}) (16... Qb7 $2 17. c3 {White is
doing well. Try to find a stronger queen move.}) (16... Qb8 $2 17. c3 {White
is doing well. Try to find a stronger queen move.}) (16... Be6 $2 17. Rhe1 {
Black is slightly better, but it's much stronger to make a fork with your
queen. How should you do it?}) 17. Kd2 {Great move! What should you capture
first?} Bxd3 {[%wrong There's a better move. Look for a good capture and try
again.] [%hint Trade bishops before capturing a pawn.]} (17... Qxb2 $5 {
This is a good move, but another capture is even stronger. Try to find it.}) (
17... Qd5 $2 18. Ke2 {White is OK. Try to find a winning capture.}) (17... Qa5+
$2 18. Ke2 {White is only slightly worse. Try to find a winning capture.}) 18.
cxd3 {Good choice! What should you capture next?} Qxb2+ {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try to find a capture and check.] [%hint Capture a pawn with
check.] White's king is completely exposed and Black is winning. Good work!} *

sacrifice material to break through against Black's kingside.} (11... Ne5 $5

the g7-bishop is restricted. Try to find a stronger pawn move.}) (11... h6 $2
12. Nxc6 {White captures on h6 next and Black is in trouble. Try to find a
better pawn move.}) 0-1

{How should White advance a pawn to reach the popular Yugoslav Attack?} 7. f3 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a way to defend g4 with a pawn.] 
[%hint Defend g4 and e4 with a pawn.]} (7. Be2 $5 {This is reasonable, but
it's more popular to reach the Yugoslav Attack by controlling g4 with a pawn.
How should you do it?}) (7. Qd2 $2 Ng4 {White will have to lose time to
preserve the bishop pair. Try to find a way to control g4.}) (7. h3 $2 O-O {
Black has a comfortable position. How should you defend g4 with another pawn?})
(7. a4 $5 {This is OK, but most players choose to prevent Black from playing
Ng4. How do they do it?}) 7... O-O {Great move! How should you prepare to
castle?} 8. Qd2 {[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try to find a way to prepare
queenside castling.] [%hint Create a queen-bishop battery and prepare to
castle.] Good work! White is ready to castle queenside and start a kingside
pawn storm.} (8. g4 $5 {This is reasonable, but it's more flexible to prepare
to castle queenside right away. How should you do that?}) (8. Be2 $5 {This is
reasonable, but it's more flexible to prepare to castle queenside right away.
How should you do that?}) (8. Bc4 $5 {This is reasonable, but it's more
flexible to prepare to castle queenside right away. How should you do that?}) (
8. Qe2 $2 Nc6 {There's a better square for the queen. Try to find it.}) (8. Qd3
$2 Nc6 {There's a better square for the queen. Try to find it.}) *

having played Bc4.} (9... Nxd4 $2 10. Bxd4 {White keeps the initiative. Try to
find a stronger move.}) (9... Bd7 $2 10. g4 {White keeps the initiative. Try

{Most players with the black pieces like to keep developing here and sacrifice
an exchange. How should you do it?} 13... Be6 {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try to find the best square for your c8 bishop.] [%hint Develop your c8 bishop
to its best square.]} (13... Re8 $5 {This is playable, but it's more popular
to sacrifice the exchange and develop a bishop. How should you doit?}) (13...
Rb8 $5 {This is playable, but most strong players choose to develop the c8
bishop. How should you do it?}) (13... Bf5 $2 14. g4 {There's a safer square
for your bishop. Try to find it.}) (13... Bd7 $2 14. Bc4 {There's a more
active square for your bishop. Try to find it.}) (13... Bb7 $2 14. Bc4 {
There's a more active square for your bishop. Try to find it.}) (13... Nxc3 $2
14. Qxd8 {White wins material. Try again and look for a strong developing move.
}) (13... Nb4 $2 {This move sacrifices more than the exchange.} 14. Qxd8 {
White wins material. Try again and look for a strong developing move.}) (13...
Qa5 $2 14. Bxf8 {Black doesn't have enough compensation for the sacrificed
exchange. Try again and look for a better developing move.}) (13... Ne3 $2 {
That move would lose more than the exchange. Consider a calm developing move
instead.} 14. Qxd8) (13... e4 $2 {This move does not develop a piece. Keep
looking.}) (13... Qe8 $2 {This move does not develop a piece. Keep looking.})
14. Bxf8 {Great start! White shouldn't have taken the rook. How should you
recapture on f8?} Qxf8 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for
a strong capture.] [%hint Recapture and get your queen off of the d-file.] 
Well played! Black's bishops and open b-file to the white king, give more than
enough compensation for the sacrificed exchange!} (14... Bxf8 $2 {There's no
need to undevelop a piece. Try to find a better capture.}) (14... Kxf8 $2 15.
Bc4 {White is doing well. Try to find a better capture.}) (14... Qb6 $2 15.
Bxg7 {White wins material. Try again and look for a good capture.}) (14... Nxc3
$2 15. Qxd8 {White wins material. Try again and look for a stronger capture.})
(14... Qa5 $2 15. Bxg7 {White wins material. Try again and look for a good
capture.}) (14... Rb8 $2 15. Bxg7 {White wins material. Try again and look for
a good capture.}) (14... Nb4 $2 15. Bxb4 {White wins material. Try again and
look for a strong capture.}) (14... Ne3 $2 {This move would lose material.
It's better to recapture on f8. But which way is best?}) (14... Qe8 $2 {
Perhaps this was a mouse slip. Of course, it's better to capture the bishop
with your queen.}) *
